bookTitle: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
author: George R.R. Martin
notes: Martin's three Dunk and Egg novellas—The Hedge Knight, The Sworn Sword, and The Mystery Knight—follow a wandering hedge knight and his squire (secretly Prince Aegon Targaryen) through Westeros a century before the War of the Five Kings. These are Martin's most purely enjoyable stories: compact, character-driven adventures about honor and class that avoid the sprawl and cruelty of the main series. HBO is betting Peter Claffey and Dexter Sol Ansell can anchor a more intimate, episodic take on Westeros after House of the Dragon proved the franchise still has juice. The novellas are short, self-contained, and among Martin's best prose—read them first, because they're the rare prequel that works as both setup and standalone pleasure.
